usage: The word 豬 (zyu1) is a noun used to refer to a pig, commonly found on farms.
In Cantonese, 豬 can be used in singular or plural forms depending on context, but the word itself does not change.
You can use 豬 in sentences to indicate ownership or presence, such as 我的豬 (my pig) or farm-related phrases.
豬 is often combined with verbs related to farming or animal care, like 餵豬 (feed pigs) or 賣豬 (sell pigs).
